explanation: Strongest on a small set of word-initial subword fragments: 'Q' (Qantas, QAnon, Qhairil), 'Prem'/'Pres' (Premier, premiership, Presbytery), 'uns' (unsimplified), 'Ak'. Moderate activations fall on unrelated tokens in math reasoning ('Wait,', 'to', '$,'), so the set of triggers has no evident common theme beyond being the start of a split word.
